projects.title: Discussion-Topic Text Classification Course Project
bullets: Cleaned public discussion-topic text records using Python and pandas as part of a supervised undergraduate team course project.
Implemented a bag-of-words classifier with scikit-learn for classifying short public text documents within the course project.

research.title: Question-Category Text Classification Research Assistance
bullets: Cleaned public question-category text records using Python and pandas while assisting with supervised faculty research on short-document classification.
Implemented a bag-of-words classifier with scikit-learn for short public text documents as a student research assistant.
